country.title: Country code (2-letter ISO; sets the LG server region)
country.description: Use your LG ThinQ account's country, e.g. NZ, TW, AU, KR, US, GB. Not hard-coded. NZ and TW are both in the Asia-Pacific (kic) region.

tokenFile.title: Absolute path to the PAT token file (recommended)

token.title: Personal Access Token (if not using a token file)

deviceId.title: Device ID (required when you have more than one dehumidifier)

waterFullSensor.title: Water-full notification sensor type (Apple Home)
waterFullSensor.description: Apple Home only pushes alerts for certain sensor types. Contact is the quietest; Leak is closest in meaning but Apple raises a Critical Alert; None creates no sensor. The alert wording cannot be customized in the Home app (only the sensor's name).

nativeTimerHours.title: Native off-timer options (whole hours)
nativeTimerHours.description: Run by the dehumidifier. Default 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8 hours; the actually available durations are decided by LG.

nativeTimerDefaultHours.title: Default hours when turning on the main timer switch
nativeTimerDefaultHours.description: Must be one of nativeTimerHours; if left empty, the first available duration is used.
